notes: ἀπό → by reason of: the carrier is a proper preposition, where rule 67 leaves the head open. The unit follows the corpus run heading by reason of on by; heading on reason remains defensible and the note records it.
s020 χειρός takes on with the governed word: καθάπτω governs the genitive and the ASV writes a verb word of its own (fastened), which is rule 106's oblique arm.
ἐξελθοῦσα keeps out inside the verb's unit because the following expressed preposition is ἀπό, whose own English is written separately, so nothing competes for the preverb's particle.
All three variant units are underdetermined on the base reading; the ASV's alternative-rendering note does not change the token partition.
